query:
UPDATE inspections 
SET status = 'completed'
WHERE projectId = 13452894 
AND inspectionType IN (
  'BLDG LINTEL OR COLUMN OR TIE BEAM',
  'ELECT UFER GROUND INSPECTION', 
  'BLDG SLAB AND OR FOUNDATION',
  'PLUMB UNDERGROUND',
  'PLUMB SEWER LATERAL',
  'PLUMB ROUGH - 1ST'
);
